title: MxAgile Requirement
description: Canonical atomic traceable requirement. Canonical location: requirements/REQ-NNN.yml. Primary key: ID. Consumed by build_artifact_index.py for DERIVED_FROM edges (derivedFrom) and IMPLEMENTED_BY edges (spec references).

ID.description: Stable unique identifier. Primary key in the artifact index. Must match filename stem (REQ-001.yml -> ID: REQ-001).

description.description: Requirement text. User story format preferred: 'As a [role], I want [action], so that [value].' For system requirements, plain declarative form is acceptable.

status.description: draft: authored but not reviewed. accepted: approved for implementation. deferred: postponed. superseded: replaced by another requirement.

source.description: Provenance: native = authored directly in MxAgile canonical format, legacy = pre-MxAgile artifact preserved in place, migrated = converted from legacy planning/stories/*.md by the canonicalization lifecycle.

derivedFrom.description: Optional page ID this requirement ORIGINATES FROM (provenance). Records which screen was the source of this requirement during Discovery. Creates a DERIVED_FROM edge in the artifact index: Page -> Requirement. Single value — provenance is a point origin, not applicability. Do NOT overload this field for multi-screen applicability — use the 'screens' field instead.

screens.description: Optional list of PAGE-NNN identifiers where this Requirement is applicable (displayed, enforced, or verified). A Requirement may apply to multiple screens even if it originated from one. Creates APPLIES_TO edges in the artifact index: Requirement -> Page (for each screen). Use for Screen -> Requirement lookup. Not a replacement for derivedFrom — derivedFrom is provenance, screens is applicability scope. See policies/impact-resolution.md.

target_users.description: User roles affected by or relevant to this requirement.

description.description: What this role can do in the context of this requirement.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format.

id.description: Stable identifier within this requirement, e.g., AC-001.

source_ac_ref.description: Optional back-reference to the source AC identifier this canonical AC derives from. Convenience field; authoritative traceability is in source_ac_coverage at the requirement level.

source_ac_coverage.description: Source-traceability map from Design Contract acceptance criteria to canonical ACs. Populated when this Requirement was created or refined from a Design Contract source. Every material source AC must be covered by exactly one entry. Enables deterministic validation that no semantic content was silently discarded during refinement. See policies/design-contract-intake.md AC COVERAGE COMPLETENESS.

source_ac_id.description: Identifier of the source acceptance criterion from the Design Contract (e.g. AC-001, or <req_id>-AC-3 for positional reference).

disposition.description: PRESERVED: source AC carried verbatim or near-verbatim. REFINED: source AC substantially preserved but re-expressed with different wording. MERGED: source AC combined with one or more other source ACs into a single canonical AC. SPLIT: source AC expressed as multiple canonical ACs. NOT_APPLICABLE: source AC explicitly excluded — exclusion_reason required.

canonical_ac_ids.description: AC identifiers in this requirement that cover the source AC. Required for PRESERVED/REFINED/MERGED/SPLIT. Empty or absent only for NOT_APPLICABLE.

exclusion_reason.description: Required when disposition is NOT_APPLICABLE. Must explain why the source AC does not require a canonical equivalent (e.g. 'covered by business rule BR-001', 'scope boundary — belongs to platform module', 'superseded by AC-003 which encompasses this').

business_rules.description: Specific business rules, constraints, or validation logic relevant to this requirement.

entity.description: Mendix entity or concept this rule applies to.

open_items.description: Unresolved DECISION REQUIRED items. A requirement with open_items should not be marked accepted.

business_context.description: Optional: describes the business problem this requirement addresses (Fachliches Problem).

out_of_scope.description: Explicit exclusions to prevent scope creep.

migrated_from.description: Source file path relative to project root, e.g., planning/stories/REQ-001.md. Set by the canonicalization lifecycle. Must be present when source = migrated.

migration_date.description: ISO date when this requirement was converted by the canonicalization lifecycle.
